exposure: Women without PAS who underwent cesarean delivery
Women without PAS who underwent vaginal delivery
Women with PAS who underwent cesarean delivery
Women with PAS who underwent vaginal delivery
outcome: Type of IUBT placement (transabdominal vs. vaginal)
Duration from delivery to Bakri insertion
cohort: 198 women who underwent treatment for postpartum hemorrhage using Bakri intrauterine balloon tamponade
finding: Placenta accreta spectrum disorder was a major cause of postpartum hemorrhage, and accurate and timely pre-IUBT intervention and Bakri IUBT placement were critical for controlling PPH in cesarean births, especially in women with PAS.
mod_finding: Cesarean births were associated with a higher proportion of pre-IUBT interventions and transabdominal IUBT placement compared to vaginal births.
